transformation.name: OSGB36 to WGS 84 (6)
transformation.areaOfUse: Great Britain onshore and the Isle of Man.

corrections.description: Moves Northern Ireland features in an ONS UK-wide British National Grid release to where the ONS's own WGS84 releases place them. In these files Northern Ireland sits a linear transform away from its true grid position: about 66 m east and 11 m south at Belfast, 50 m east and 21 m south at Enniskillen. Great Britain is unaffected. No published OSGB36 or TM65 transformation reproduces the shift, so it is corrected empirically.
